name: Politoed
description: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
